messages:
Sara: heads-up — Acme reported 'audit log export for private deployment' twice via support & sales. Tickets: #2345 (support), #5780 (sales). Can we merge and pick canonical ask? @Kevin?
Kevin: thanks. Do we have an existing backlog item for 'private audit logs'?
Maya: there's a PRD stub P-912 in backlog but it's scoped broader (auditing + retention). These two customer asks are specifically CSV export + S3 export.
Eli: ok, propose we create canonical ticket 'exportable audit logs for private deployments' and tag duplicates as blocked-by it. proposal: priority = p2 by default unless CS says revenue impact.
Sara: Acme is mid-market with a compliance deadline next quarter. Sales says this would tip the deal — leaning p1. :eyes:
Kevin: let's avoid scope creep. We can ship a minimal export (CSV + S3 push) for private in 1 sprint. Launch criteria: auth-filtered audit entries, export endpoint, S3 config options (role/ARN), sample size limit, and basic audit QA. Add checklist for security review.
Maya: I'll update P-912 to reference a minimal-export subtask and add tags: cust:acme-corp, source:support,sales, dup:true, status:triage
triage-bot: merged ticket created -> PROD-3146. Original tickets #2345, #5780 linked. assignee: Maya.
Eli: assigning to Maya for scoping. @Kevin / eng, can you add an engineering estimate? Need to confirm private infra changes (KMS, S3 presign, network).
Kevin: eng estimate: API + backend 2w, UI + settings 1w, QA + security review 1w = 4w. We can cut UI (deliver API + CLI first) to shorten timeline. :+1:
Sara: I'll reply to ACME with the consolidated update and tentative timeline. Draft: "We've consolidated your requests into one tracked ticket (PROD-3146). Targeting a minimal export in ~4 weeks; we'll update if scope changes." Thoughts?
Maya: fine. updating PROD-3146 now. backlog tags: "customer:acme-corp", "priority:high", "duplicate_of:PROD-3146" added to originals.
Kevin: can we add a small automation to notify the requester when PROD-3146 status changes? add to rollout checklist so CS gets updates.
triage-bot: note added -> watchers: Sara, sales-team, eng-product. Next action: Maya to post scope doc by EOD Tue.
Maya: putting tentative scope doc at https://redwood.company/notes/PROD-3146 (private link). Will ping when ready.
Sara: thanks — will inform customer and set expectation. Closing slack thread. :white_check_mark:
